rules.title: The new tasks are appended after the existing ones with the given values
The Status dropdown applies to every task row, including the new ones
rules.detail: the Status dropdown does not cover D14, D15, D16, D17, D18

rules.title: Every task row, including the new ones, is highlighted in red exactly when its Status is 'Blocked'
rules.detail: D15, D16 (Status 'Blocked') are not highlighted in red; for D15: no conditional format that sets a colour applies to it
